name: Mohamed L'Amine Gherbi
summary: Backend-oriented full-stack developer with a Master's in Software Engineering and Distributed Systems. I build with TypeScript, Next.js, PostgreSQL and Python, and bring DevOps and language-model integration to products that need verifiable output.

education.credential: Master's in Software Engineering and Distributed Systems (GLSD)

freelance.problem: Storefronts where price, stock and order state had to be decided by the server, not the browser. Checkout, admin and order flows built on Next.js and PostgreSQL.
Internal boards that replace spreadsheets for orders, routes and delivery status, with one place for dispatchers to update a job.
Course platforms with enrolment, progress and completion records that staff can audit without a second spreadsheet.
Booking and patient-record tools where each role sees the records its work needs, and changes stay traceable.
Search and question answering over PDFs, with every answer tied back to the page it came from.

projects.title: E-commerce platform
projects.line: Search, authentication, cart and Stripe test checkout with server-side price validation.

projects.title: CI/CD deployment pipeline
projects.line: Pull-request gates, a Docker image, and a local release lane with a recorded rollback.

projects.title: Document Q&A assistant
projects.line: Ask questions in natural language about uploaded PDFs and get answers with source citations.

thesis.title: Enhancing the Integrity of Algeria's Social Security System: Addressing Fraudulent Activities through Blockchain Technology
thesis.summary: A blockchain platform built to strengthen the integrity of Algeria's social security system and counter fraud across three organisations. Hyperledger Fabric backend, Next.js frontend.
